import ctypes
from ctypes import c_size_t, c_void_p

# Load the dynamic libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the gsl_movstat_alloc function
# Return type: gsl_movstat_workspace* (represented as c_void_p in ctypes)
# Argument: size_t (represented as c_size_t in ctypes)
gsl.gsl_movstat_alloc.restype = c_void_p
gsl.gsl_movstat_alloc.argtypes = [c_size_t]

# Define the gsl_movstat_free function
# Argument: gsl_movstat_workspace* (represented as c_void_p in ctypes)
gsl.gsl_movstat_free.restype = None
gsl.gsl_movstat_free.argtypes = [c_void_p]

def allocate_and_free_workspace(K):
    """Allocate and free a GSL moving statistics workspace."""
    # Call gsl_movstat_alloc
    workspace = gsl.gsl_movstat_alloc(c_size_t(K))
    if not workspace:
        raise MemoryError("Failed to allocate GSL moving statistics workspace.")

    # Free the allocated workspace
    gsl.gsl_movstat_free(workspace)

    return "Workspace allocated and freed successfully."

    else:
